1.1: This the message the Lord gave to Micah from Moresheth, back when Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings in Judah. It was about Samaria and Jerusalem.
1.2: Listen up, y'all—all people, everywhere! Earth, you too! God about to testify against y'all, comin' straight from His holy spot.
1.3: Look, the Lord steppin' out His place. He comin' down, walkin' on the high places like He runnin' the whole thing.
1.4: Mountains gon' melt like candle wax, valleys gon' crack open and slide like water rollin' off a steep hill.
1.5: All this 'cause Jacob (aka Israel) wildin' out. Their sins got outta control. What's the root of Jacob's mess? Ain't it Samaria? And them "high places" in Judah? Ain't that Jerusalem?
1.6: So Samaria? Gon' be turned into straight rubble. Folks gon' be plantin' vineyards where cities used to be. God gon' throw them stones downhill and rip up the whole foundation.
1.7: All them little idol statues? Smashed. All the money they made hustlin'? Burned up. Them idols gon' be left lookin' sad and broke. She got it actin' like a harlot, and it's gon' go back to that same dirty cycle.
1.8: I'ma cry out loud for real. I'ma be out here barefoot, butt naked, howlin' like a wild dog, mournin' like an ostrich. That pain deep.
1.9: 'Cause the wounds? Too deep to fix. This thing done hit Judah now—right up to the gate of my own people. It's knockin' on Jerusalem's door.
1.10: Don't even speak on it in Gath. Don't cry out there. But in Beth Aphrah, roll in the dirt—show that grief.
1.11: Shaphir folks, y'all gon' walk out in shame, bare. Zaanan folks too scared to even step outside. Beth Ezel cryin', and you ain't got nowhere safe to stand.
1.12: The people of Maroth waitin' for good news, but what's comin' is straight disaster from the Lord, right to Jerusalem's gate.
1.13: Lachish, y'all better get that chariot ready—y'all was the first ones to pass them sinful vibes down to Zion. Israel's wrongdoings showed up right there with you.
1.14: So now you gotta send farewell gifts to Moresheth Gath. And Achzib? That city gon' play the kings—nothin' but false hope.
1.15: But listen, Mareshah—you got somebody comin' for your spot. Israel's glory gon' be forced to hide out in Adullam.
1.16: Go on and shave your head, mourn hard for your babies. Make yourself bald like an eagle, 'cause your kids about to be snatched up into captivity.

2.1: Woe to them folks who be sittin' up in bed plottin' evil—layin' out wrong like it's a business plan. Soon as the sun come up, they out there doin' dirt, just 'cause they can.
2.2: They greedy for folks' land and straight up snatch it. Same with houses—they take what ain't theirs. They rob a man of his home and his whole legacy.
2.3: So the Lord said, "Bet. I got somethin' cooked up for y'all too—a disaster you can't duck. Y'all won't be able to hold your heads high no more. This ain't the time to act big."
2.4: That day gon' hit hard. Folks gon' be singin' sad songs 'bout y'all, talkin' 'bout: 'We done lost everything. God switched up our blessing and gave it away to folks that don't even rock with us.'
2.5: Ain't gon' be nobody left to split up land for you when it's time to divvy up God's promise. You out.
2.6: Y'all out here tellin' prophets, "Stop talkin', hush up." So cool—God gon' stop speakin' to you. Y'all won't be hearin' no good word back.
2.7: Oh house of Jacob, y'all really think God don't move like He used to? You think He switched up? Nah, His words still bless those who live right.
2.8: But lately, y'all actin' like ops to your own people. Runnin' up on folks who trusted you—strippin' the clothes off their backs like war just ended.
2.9: Y'all kickin' women out their homes, robbin' children of their future, snatchin' away My glory like it don't mean nothin'.
2.10: So get up and go. This land ain't gon' be your peace anymore. It's tainted. And it's gon' chew you up and spit you out.
2.11: Some slick-tongued dude can come up talkin' nonsense like, "Lemme give y'all a prophecy 'bout wine and good times," and that's the kinda voice y'all love to hear. For real?
2.12: But look—I still got y'all. I'ma bring My people back together, every last one that's left. Like sheep gathered up safe, packed close in the field—so many it's gon' be loud.
2.13: The one breakin' through gon' lead y'all out. Y'all gon' pass through that gate and walk free. Your King gon' walk ahead of you. And the Lord? He at the front of the line.

3.1: Then I said, "Ayo, listen up—y'all leaders of Jacob, y'all big dogs in Israel. Ain't it your job to know what justice look like?"
3.2: But nah, y'all hate what's good and love what's evil. Y'all be skinning My people alive—strippin' 'em bare like they ain't even human.
3.3: Y'all eatin' folk up—breakin' their bones, tearin' up their bodies like meat in a stew pot. You treatin' folks like food, not family.
3.4: But best believe, a time comin' where y'all gon' cry out to Me—but I ain't listenin'. I'm gon' hide My face, 'cause y'all been movin' foul.
3.5: Now here's what the Lord got to say 'bout them fake prophets out here: y'all got My people twisted. You singin' lullabies about peace when your belly full, but as soon as somebody ain't feedin' you, it's smoke and war.
3.6: So guess what? Ain't gon' be no more visions. Dark times comin'. No dreams, no prophecies. Sun goin' down on all y'all so-called prophets.
3.7: All them "seers" gon' be lookin' real foolish. The fortune-tellers gon' be embarrassed too. They gon' cover their mouths 'cause God ain't speakin' to none of them.
3.8: But me? I'm powered up with the Spirit of the Lord. I got strength, justice, and boldness to call y'all out—Jacob, Israel, all y'all—on y'all mess.
3.9: Now hear this, you crooked leaders of Jacob and Israel—y'all hate justice, twistin' everything to fit your own agenda.
3.10: You build Zion off bloodshed. Y'all stackin' bricks with people's pain. Jerusalem built off straight-up wrongdoing.
3.11: The judges only judge if the check clear. Priests won't teach unless you cashin' 'em out. Prophets out here sellin' prophecies for a price. Yet they still talkin' like, "God got us. We good. Can't nothin' happen to us."
3.12: But 'cause of y'all, Zion gon' get plowed like farmland. Jerusalem? A pile of rubble. And that temple mount? It's gon' look like a raggedy forest hill. No glory, just dust.

4.1: One day, in the days up ahead, the Lord's crib—the mountain where His house sit—is gon' be set up high, way above all the other hills. And folks from everywhere gon' be flockin' to it.
4.2: Whole nations gon' be sayin', "Come on, let's roll up to the Lord's mountain, to the house of Jacob's God. He gon' teach us how to live right, and we gon' walk that path He show us." 'Cause outta Zion gon' come the law, and the Lord's word straight outta Jerusalem.
4.3: He gon' settle disputes between folks, check even the strongest nations from far off. Swords? They gon' be turned into plows. Spears? Turned into garden tools. Ain't gon' be no more war training. Ain't nobody pickin' up arms no more.
4.4: Folks gon' be chillin' under they own vine and fig tree—peaceful, unbothered. Ain't nobody out here scaring folks. The Lord Himself said it, and that's on everything.
4.5: Other folks might walk in the name of they little gods, but as for us? We walkin' in the name of the Lord our God, forever and ever.
4.6: The Lord say, "When that time come, I'ma gather up the ones who been limpin', left out, pushed aside—the ones I had to break down."
4.7: "I'ma take the lame ones and make 'em My people. The ones the world threw away? I'ma turn 'em into a whole strong nation. I'ma rule over them from Mount Zion—forever."
4.8: And you, Tower of the Flock—Zion's stronghold—yo time comin'. Everything you lost, gon' be given back. Royalty gon' rise again in Jerusalem.
4.9: So why you cryin' now? Ain't there a king in you? Where your advisor at? You sound like a woman goin' through labor pains.
4.10: Cry out, push through, daughter of Zion. You about to give birth to something new. But first, you gon' leave the city, live in the field, and end up in Babylon. But it's there—right there—I'ma come through and save you. I'ma get you outta enemy hands.
4.11: Yeah, nations all around got they eyes on you. They talkin' wild like, "Let her fall. Let us feast on her downfall."
4.12: But they don't even know God's plan. They ain't peeped how He move. He stackin' all them folks together like wheat, just waitin' to thresh.
4.13: "Get up, daughter of Zion! Time to stomp. I'm makin' your horns like iron, your hooves like bronze. You gon' crush these nations. All that they gain? All that wealth? That's comin' to Me. It's all gon' be holy—belongin' to the Lord of the whole earth."

5.1: Aight now, gather up, daughter of troops—y'all battlin' out here. The enemy settin' up shop, surroundin' us. They gon' smack Israel's judge in the face with a stick.
5.2: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah—You might seem small compared to all Judah's cities, But outta you gon' come somebody big for Me—The One who gon' rule over Israel. He been around since way back—eternity-type back.
5.3: So God gon' let things play out for a while, Till the one in labor give birth. Then the rest of His people—His fam—gon' come back home to Israel.
5.4: He gon' stand strong, take care of His people like a real Shepherd, Powered up by the Lord, movin' in His name. His folks gon' live in peace, 'Cause His name gon' stretch worldwide.
5.5: And this King? Yeah—He gon' be our peace. When the Assyrians roll up on us, When they step in our homes—We gon' raise up seven shepherds, shoot, maybe even eight leaders ready to handle business.
5.6: They gon' wreck Assyria with the sword, Even the land of Nimrod at the gates. He gon' save us from the Assyrian threat When they try to cross into our space.
5.7: The leftover crew from Jacob? They gon' be out here among the nations like morning dew—Like soft showers on the grass, Ain't waitin' on nobody, Ain't need no permission.
5.8: That remnant of Jacob? They gon' be like a lion in the middle of the wild—Like a young lion rollin' through a flock of sheep. When they come through? It's a wrap—stompin' and tearin' through. Ain't nobody savin' nothin'.
5.9: Your hand gon' be lifted high against all your enemies, And every single one of 'em? Gone.
5.10: The Lord say, "When that day hit, I'm gettin' rid of all y'all's horses and chariots—no more military flexin'.
5.12: I'ma shut down all that magic, Ain't gon' be no fortune tellers left.
5.13: Y'all idols? I'ma break every last one. No more bowin' to stuff you built with your own hands.
5.14: Them wooden gods? Ripped out. Cities? Flattened.
5.15: I'm comin' with heat—real vengeance—On all them nations that ain't listen."

6.1: Aight now, listen up to what the Lord sayin': "Get up—go make your case. Let the mountains hear you out, And let the hills tune in too.
6.2: Y'all mountains, y'all strong foundations of the earth, Hear the Lord out—He got a complaint against His people, And He takin' it up with Israel.
6.3: My people, what did I do to you? How I wearied you? Go 'head and speak on it—what's the charge?
6.4: Didn't I bring y'all up outta Egypt? Freed you from that slave house? Didn't I send Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to lead the way?
6.5: My people, remember what Balak, king of Moab, tried to pull? And how Balaam, Beor's son, had to answer him? From Shittim to Gilgal—I was showin' y'all how righteous I am."
6.6: So now…what I'm supposed to bring to the Lord? How I'm supposed to bow before the Most High? Burnt offerings? Year-old calves?
6.7: Will the Lord be impressed with thousands of rams? Ten thousand rivers of oil? Should I even offer up my firstborn for my sins? My own child for the wrong I done?
6.8: Naw. He already showed you what's good, fam. And what He want from you is simple: Do right. Love mercy. Walk humble with your God.
6.9: The Lord's voice boomin' through the city—And if you got any wisdom, you gon' pay attention: "Listen when the rod speaks—ask yourself who sent it.
6.10: Is wickedness still sittin' comfy in these houses? Folks still out here usin' short measures that ain't right?
6.11: You think I'm gon' act like that's pure? When you usin' crooked scales and got a bag full of lies?
6.12: Your rich folks violent, Your people stay lyin', And them tongues slick with deceit.
6.13: So yeah—I'ma strike y'all down. You gon' feel it. Gon' be sick and empty 'cause of your sin.
6.14: You'll eat, but never be full—Your hunger gon' linger. You'll try to hold on to what you got, But it won't save you. Even what you manage to keep? I'ma let the sword take that too.
6.15: You'll plant seeds, but you ain't gon' reap nothin'. You'll stomp olives, but not get no oil. Make wine, but not a sip to drink.
6.16: Y'all still followin' Omri's crooked rules, Still walkin' in Ahab's dirty footsteps. So guess what? I'ma leave y'all desolate. Folks gon' see you and hiss—You gon' carry the shame of My people."

7.1: Man…woe is me. I feel like somebody who out here tryna find summer fruit, Tryna pick them last grapes off the vine—Ain't nothin' good left, not even one ripe one for my soul to enjoy.
7.2: Ain't no real ones left on earth. Not a single upright soul in sight. Everybody out here tryna catch a body, They huntin' each other like wild animals in a trap.
7.3: Folks out here wildin' with both hands—real coordinated with the evil. The prince takin' bribes, The judge crooked too, And the big dogs just say what they want, Then they all link up to make it happen.
7.4: Even the "best" of them? They like thorns and barbed wire. The straightest ones still sharp enough to cut you. But the watchman's day—the one who sees what's comin'—Yeah, it's finally here. And now they all confused.
7.5: Don't even trust your homeboy. Don't put no faith in your ride-or-die. Keep your mouth shut—even 'round your boo thang layin' in your arms.
7.6: 'Cause sons turn on their daddies, Daughters pop off on their mamas, Daughters-in-law throw shade at their husbands' mamas, And the folks under your own roof? That's your biggest threat.
7.7: But me? I'ma keep my eyes on the Lord. I'ma wait on my God to come through with salvation. He gon' hear me when I call.
7.8: Don't you dare gloat over me, enemy. Yeah, I might fall…but I'ma get back up. I might be sittin' in the dark right now, But the Lord gon' be my light.
7.9: I messed up, and I'ma take this L. I'ma sit with the consequences 'til God steps in, Pleads my case, brings justice, And walks me back into the light. Then I'll see His righteousness clear as day.
7.10: The one who was tryna clown me, Talkin' slick like "Where your God at now?" Yeah, she gon' see. She gon' be filled with shame. I'ma see her get dragged like dirt in the streets.
7.11: In that day, when your walls goin' up, That decree gon' go global.
7.12: People gon' come to you from Assyria, From locked-down cities, from across rivers, From sea to sea, from mountain to mountain.
7.13: But the land gon' still look empty and tore up, All 'cause of the wild mess they did.
7.14: Lord, go 'head and shepherd Your folks—Your chosen ones. The ones who out here dwellin' quiet in the woods. Let 'em eat good in Bashan and Gilead, Like they used to back in the day.
7.15: Just like back when You brought us outta Egypt, Do it again—show us them wonders.
7.16: The nations gon' be stunned silent, All their so-called power? Embarrassed. They gon' cover their mouths, And they ears won't even work right from the shock.
7.17: They gon' eat dirt like snakes, Slither out they lil' holes lookin' scared. They gon' fear You, Lord—And be shook at how mighty You are.
7.18: Who you know that's like our God?! Forgivin' sins and lookin' past our mess. He don't stay mad forever—Nah, He actually enjoys showin' mercy.
7.19: He gon' come back with compassion, He gon' stomp out our sins. He throwin' all that mess into the sea, Deep where nobody can go fishin' for it.
7.20: You gon' stay true to Jacob, Show mercy to Abraham, Just like You promised our ancestors Back in the day.
